text: I In you, Lord, I take refuge; [AA]let me never be put to shame. [AB]
In your justice rescue and deliver me;listen to me and save me!
Be my rock of refuge,my stronghold to give me safety;for you are my rock and fortress. [AC]
My God, rescue me from the hand of the wicked,from the clutches of the evil and violent. [AD]
You are my hope, Lord;my trust, God, from my youth.
On you I have depended since birth;from my mother's womb you are my strength; [AE]my hope in you never wavers.
t[1]I have become a portent to many,but you are my strong refuge!
My mouth shall be filled with your praise,shall sing your glory every day.
II Do not cast me aside in my old age;as my strength fails, do not forsake me.
For my enemies speak against me;they watch and plot against me. [AF]
They say, "God has abandoned him.Pursue, and seize him!No one will come to the rescue!"
God, be not far from me;my God, hasten to help me. [AG]
Bring to a shameful endthose who attack me;Cover with contempt and scornthose who seek my ruin. [AH]
I will always hope in youand add to all your praise.
My mouth shall proclaim your just deeds,day after day your acts of deliverance,though I cannot number them all. [AI]
I will speak of the mighty works of the Lord;O God, I will tell of your singular justice.
III God, you have taught me from my youth;to this day I proclaim your wondrous deeds.
Now that I am old and gray, [AJ]do not forsake me, God,That I may proclaim your mightto all generations yet to come, [AK]Your power
and justice, God,to the highest heaven.You have done great things; [AL]O God, who is your equal? [AM]
Whatever bitter afflictions you sent me,you would turn and revive me.From the watery depths of the earthonce more raise me up.
Restore my honor;turn and comfort me,
That I may praise you with the lyrefor your faithfulness, my God,And sing to you with the harp,O Holy One of Israel!
My lips will shout for joy as I sing your praise;my soul, too, which you have redeemed.
Yes, my tongue shall recountyour justice day by day.For those who sought my ruinhave been shamed and disgraced.
